name: plopino
description: Publish an HTML page, a document, a file, or a folder to Plopino and get a public link.

token.title: Plopino token (optional)
token.description: Leave empty to publish anonymously — that is the default flow and needs no account. A token from plopino.com/b publishes to your account instead: private boards, in-place updates that keep the same link, and no per-IP rate limit.
